title: Experiment II SQL Grounding Dataset
description: Schema for manually curated SQL grounding cases used to compare S1 Static Schema, S2 Dynamic Schema Grounding, and S3 Full Grounded SQL Pipeline.

dataset_name.description: Stable dataset identifier, for example sql_grounding_cases.

version.description: Dataset version used to freeze the evaluation run, for example 1.0.0.

description.description: Short explanation of the dataset purpose and construction rules.

total_cases.description: Total number of SQL cases. For the planned experiment this should be 80.

database_snapshot.description: Database snapshot information used to make SQL execution results reproducible.

snapshot_id.description: Stable identifier for the database dump or evaluation database version.

description.description: Human-readable description of the snapshot contents.

created_at.description: Optional ISO-8601 timestamp for the snapshot creation time.

distribution.description: Expected stratification of SQL cases by complexity category.

sql_complexity_counts.description: Number of cases for each SQL complexity category.

single_table_query.description: Count of simple single-table selection or filtering cases.

multi_table_join.description: Count of cases requiring joins or data from multiple views.

aggregation.description: Count of COUNT, AVG, SUM, GROUP BY, or similar aggregation cases.

nested_query.description: Count of EXISTS, IN, subquery, or nested selection cases.

window_function.description: Count of ranking, trend, or comparative analytics cases using SQL window functions.

conditional_aggregation.description: Count of cases requiring CASE WHEN or conditional aggregation.

ambiguous_or_typo_entity.description: Count of cases requiring entity resolution because the user phrase contains typo, abbreviation, or informal name.

questionnaire_metadata.description: Count of cases requiring catalog lookup for questionnaire code or option metadata.

cases.description: SQL evaluation cases. Each case should isolate one main SQL grounding challenge.

id.description: Unique case identifier. Recommended format: SQL-CATEGORY-###, for example SQL-ENTITY-001.

sql_complexity.description: SQL challenge category used for stratified reporting.

question.description: Natural language task sent to the SQL pipeline.

user_scope.description: User access scope used during SQL generation and execution.

allowed_faculties.description: Optional faculty codes allowed for this user.

allowed_programs.description: Optional study program identifiers allowed for this user.

allowed_courses.description: Optional course codes allowed for this user.

plan_step_context.description: Plan step context passed to the SQL pipeline so S1, S2, and S3 solve the same subtask.

task.description: Current step task that SQL should solve.

tool.description: Expected tool label. For this experiment it should normally be sql.

required.description: Whether catalog_lookup should be used before SQL generation in S3.

prior_steps_context.description: Optional context from previous steps, especially for questionnaire_metadata cases. Use an empty string if not needed.

expected_grounding.description: Expected schema linking and entity grounding outputs.

expected_tables.description: Tables or views that should be selected by schema_linker.

expected_entities.description: Canonical entities expected after entity resolution. Keys should match DetectedEntities fields where possible.

expected_catalog_references.description: Questionnaire codes, option groups, or metadata labels expected from catalog_lookup. Use an empty array when not applicable.

expected_sql_behavior.description: SQL-level expectations used for validation, execution accuracy, and result scoring.

must_include_sql_patterns.description: SQL fragments, table names, columns, clauses, or operations that should appear in a correct SQL query.

must_not_include_sql_patterns.description: SQL fragments, unsafe operations, sensitive columns, or wrong tables that must not appear.

expected_result_facts.description: Facts expected from executing a correct SQL query. Can be exact values, row-count expectations, or semantic result requirements.

gold_sql.description: Optional gold SQL for reference. Use null if scoring is based only on execution result facts.

numeric_tolerance.description: Optional tolerance for numeric result comparison.

scoring.description: Metric-specific scoring flags for this case.

execution_accuracy_required.description: Whether execution accuracy should be scored for this case.

schema_selection_required.description: Whether schema selection accuracy is meaningful for this case.

entity_resolution_required.description: Whether entity resolution is expected to affect this case.

catalog_lookup_required.description: Whether catalog_lookup is expected to affect this case.

retry_expected.description: Whether a retry may reasonably be needed for a correct final answer.

database_snapshot.description: Frozen evaluation database containing portfolio academic views and questionnaire metadata.

cases.question: Berapa rata-rata evaluasi untuk Alstrukdat semester 2024-1?

plan_step_context.task: Retrieve the average evaluation score for the course referred to as Alstrukdat in semester 2024-1.

expected_result_facts: Returns an average evaluation value for IF2110 in semester 2024-1 or a valid empty result if the database has no matching rows.
